notes.title: Bug fixes and more!
notes.content:
Thank you all for your feedback! This update addresses most if not all of the bugs that were present, as well as some QOL and balance changes! 

Here's the full list of changes and fixes: 

General fixes:

 Fixed carbine animation bug 
 Fixed melee and ranged drone animation bug 
 Fixed corpses blocking players way
 Fixed ammo pickup bug
 Fixed altfire for AR's not costing ammo (lol)
 Fixed kick stunning working on every boss except for the Vandal 
 Fixed Cutscenes playing too fast 
 Fixed kick and twilight mode not being binded for some players 
 Fixed HUD not working for some players
 Reworked the seal token, it now grants 30 seconds of invulnerability instead of reducing player hitboxes
 Kicked parry sound only plays once to prevent destroying ears


Map fixes: 

 Fixed seal token causing players to fall to their death on certain maps
 Fix the door not opening if it lands on the players head in map 5 (lmao) 
 Fix certain errors in map 7 


Balance/QOL changes: 

 Add a delay and a message before the perk menu shows up to prevent accidentally clicking a perk by mistake 
 Reworked normal mode so that enemy bullets and the melee drones are less threatening
 Add an outline to the non-danmaku enemy projectiles for better visibility 
 Update some perks description so it's more clear
 Added names to all of the bosses 


Thank you all so much for your support!! Have a wonderful day!!

notes.title: Bug fixes! But your clears are reset (PLEASE READ)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, today and yesterday I released some small patches that fix a few but critical bugs, including, but not limited to:


 HUD not being scaled correctly 
 Controls not being binded correctly 
 Wrong portrait being used for the girl



And don't worry, I'm aware of all of the other bugs and balancing issues and the rest should be coming in a huge update this week!

Now unfortunately, while your save data should remain intact, this does mean that your unlockable difficulties are now reset, but fear not! It should be very easy to fix, here are two step by step methods to unlock them! 

METHOD ONE: 

 Open the game 
 Close the game, a new section in the .ini file should now be created 
 Open the game directory, and open the gzdoom_portable.ini file in notepad 
 Ctrl F  "TMNormalClear", you should now see three difficulties: 
 TMHardClear=0
 TMNormalClear=0
 TMOneHitClear=0


If you beat the game on normal, set TMNormalClear from 0 to 1, if you beat the game on hard, set both TMNormalClear and TMHardClear from 0 to 1 and if you beat all three difficulties, set  TMHardClear, TMNormalClear  and TMOneHitClear from 0 to 1! 

Your unlocks should now be available. 

METHOD TWO: 

 Launch a new game and take the elevator to the new level 
 Warp to the final map by opening the console with the ` key and typing "MAP MAP07"
 Open the console again, turn on god mode and noclip by typing "god" and "noclip" 
 Noclip to the front door where the final boss is 
 Just as you pass the front door, turn off noclip so the cutscene (and the boss) activates 
 Open the console again and type "Kill Mae" 
 The final boss is now defeated and you've unlocked the next difficulty! 
 Repeat this with the next difficulty if needed
